about_the_game:
Loot, Sell, Survive — Profit from Chaos.

Oldish Stuff is a 2D action-looter game set in a collapsing world where interdimensional portals bring enemies, profit, and absurdity. As a pawnshop owner with no morals and no mercy, you raid chaotic dimensions, loot the dead, and sell their gear back to whoever's still breathing.

Your shop is more than just a storefront — it's the core of your progression. Each run through the portals brings valuable loot, rare enemy parts, and gear upgrades that feed directly into your ability to grow and automate your shady business.

Combat is fast and varied. You'll fight with melee combos, special skills, stuns, status effects, and more. The enemies you face are grotesque and hand-drawn — from cultists to mutants — and the loot they drop will change how you play.

In between battles, you'll price items, handle customer behavior, and manipulate the economy. Who buys what matters — your shop’s inventory affects future enemies, and some may come back for revenge.

🔧 Core Features:

  • Loot-driven gameplay loop: Raid dimensional rifts, defeat enemies, loot their corpses

  • Dynamic combat system: Melee, skills, stun combos, weapon-based effects

  • Progression through commerce: Sell gear, expand your shop, unlock shady perks

  • Enemy interaction economy: What you sell influences what future enemies wear

  • Stylized 2D visuals: A grim and humorous world with hand-crafted enemy designs

  • Replayability: Randomized drops, multiple enemy types, and scalable challenges

No moral choices. No heroes. Just pure unethical profit.

content_descriptors.notes: "This game contains content that is purely for humor and entertainment purposes. While the game includes absurd and exaggerated scenarios, such as fighting elderly characters and collecting items, it is important to note that these elements are not intended to promote violence or any harmful behavior. The content is designed to be satirical and should not be taken seriously. The game does not include any explicit sexual content or real-life drug use. Players are encouraged to approach the game with a lighthearted mindset."
